children.name: entity
children.description: The name of the type/entity in the schema

children.name: parents
children.description:
All parents a type/entity refers to in the schema
or through links

children.name: ref
children.description:
The reference to the schema object representation
of the parent

children.name: inSchemaRef
children.description:
When a link is inferred between two types/entities
we are configuring the link tree, and therefore we are
storing the reference to the parent type/entity within the
schema which defer from the true parent from a pure entity
point of view

children.name: targetProp
children.description: The property the data should be assigned to in the parent

children.name: inverseSideProp
children.description: The property the parent is assigned to in my side

children.name: isList
children.description: Are the data expected to be a list or not

children.name: isInverse
children.description:
Whether the entity is the inverse of the link (not the owner.):
e.g: order -> cart, order is the owner, cart is the inverse

children.name: fields
children.description: The default fields to query for the type/entity

children.name: listeners
children.description:
`@Listerners` directive is required and all listeners found
for the type will be stored here

children.name: alias
children.description:
The alias for the type/entity retrieved in the corresponding
module

children.name: moduleConfig
children.description:
The module joiner config corresponding to the module the type/entity
refers to

children.name: alias
children.description: Property name to use as entrypoint to the service

children.name: fieldAlias
children.description: alias for deeper nested relationships (e.g. { 'price': 'prices.calculated\_price\_set.amount' })

children.name: args
children.description: Extra arguments to pass to the remoteFetchData callback

children.name: schema
children.description: GraphQL schema for the all module's available entities and fields

children.name: isLink
children.description: If the module is a link module

children.name: linkableKeys
children.description: Keys that can be used to link to other modules. e.g { product\_id: "Product" } "Product" being the entity it refers to

children.name: isReadOnlyLink
children.description: If true it expands a RemoteQuery property but doesn't create a pivot table

children.name: extraDataFields
children.description:
Fields that will be part of the link record aside from the primary keys that can be updated
If not explicitly defined, this array will be populated by databaseConfig.extraFields
